contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of all four .sdata2 facts and both section links: source literals and the conditional ordering helper do not prove emitted size, padding, order, provenance or consumers.

Accept deferral of unconditional helplessness, release-pose narratives and global non-interruptibility. Air End explicitly permits ordinary Fall for zero lag; the other helper has an exceptional branch. Empty IASA proves only absence of local input handling.

Accept timer/scheduler deferral: End animation reloads gravity delay every invocation, whereas physics decrements any nonzero value. A simple eventual countdown is not established, particularly for negative counters.

Accept Hold-only naming deferrals and shared-phase clarification: active ground and air Hold/Release entries share all four callback categories. Rendered aliases cannot establish exclusive roles or original names.

Accept input-field and delay-boundary corrections. Canonical held_buttons[0] replaces held_inputs; decrement precedes eligibility, callbacks belong to the Fighter, and a configurable delay is not proved short.
Accept recovery/jump-lifetime deferral: startup's maximum-jumps assignment does not survive all terrain conversions; common conversion helpers write different jump bookkeeping.

Accept deferral of guaranteed owned/live item claims. Startup construction is conditional, may return null and does not validate existing references. Hold checking likewise proves only a stored reference and motion predicate.

Accept all ground-collision polarity deferrals and the three exact-branch corrections. Callers convert on zero, but the pinned helper returns Ground=0 and Air=1. Seamless support-loss interpretations and intended binary behavior remain unproved; shared Release conversion also selects Hold.
Accept item-state interpretation deferral: predicate state 2 is selected by collision; normal release/expiration selects state 1. Fighter loop counters do not measure completed animation loops.

Accept destruction/ownership and lifecycle corrections. The stronger helper detaches owners without destroying the item; B release only clears fighter association. Release can be skipped, End resets recur and aerial completion chooses a fall path rather than immediately applying landing lag. Supported unchanged research is retained verbatim; acceptance is limited to these changes and examined contradictions.
